newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow mayor met Moody's on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Moscow mayor met Moody's on Monday.

text.p: Moscow Mayor Yuri Luzhkov met officials from Moody's on Monday in the first of a series of talks with the agency as the capitol prepares to launch a Eurobond, a city spokesman said on Tuesday.

"At these meetings, the Mayor of Moscow, as head of the government issuing the Eurobonds is representing Moscow as a borrower," Mikhail Chernyshev, head of the public relations service of the city's municipal debt committee, told Reuters.
"Several further meetings are planned, but it is still too early to speak of any decisions being taken."
Chernyshev said Luzhkov planned to meet officials from Standard and Poor's in mid-February.
City officials have said that Moscow plans to issue a Eurobond for up to $500 million in the first half of this year.
